title: `.providerMetadata.openai.logprobs` is set to array of empty arrays
body:
### Description

Reported by @shaper 

> I've started seeing in provider metadata when dumped a variably sized empty array of empty arrays for logprobs

I was able to reproduce the problem with this example provided by @shaper. I'm looking into it

```ts
import { generateText, streamText } from 'ai';
import 'dotenv/config';
import { openai, type OpenAIResponsesProviderOptions } from '@ai-sdk/openai';

async function main() {
  const options = {
    model: openai('gpt-4o-mini'),
    prompt: 'What is specifically notable about the style of Sonoran food?',
    providerOptions: {
      openai: {
      } satisfies OpenAIResponsesProviderOptions,
    },
  }
  const streamResult = await streamText(options);

  console.log(
    'PROVIDER METADATA FORM STREAMTEXT:',
    JSON.stringify(await streamResult.providerMetadata, null, 2),
  );

  const generateResult = await generateText(options);

  console.log(
    '\nPROVIDER METADATA FORM GENERATETEXT:',
    JSON.stringify(await generateResult.providerMetadata, null, 2),
  );
}

main().catch(console.error);
```

linked_prs.title: fix(provider/ai): do not set `.providerMetadata.openai.logprobs` to an array of empty arrays when using `streamText()`

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue involves incorrect handling of provider metadata from an LLM provider (OpenAI), specifically the "logprobs" field when invoking a model. It directly concerns LLM provider integration and output parsing, which are agent-specific components per the taxonomy.
